summary: Around July 24, 2026 a suspected cyberattack disrupted work email, internet access, Google Drive, ClassLink and other applications at Oceanside Unified School District in California. The district confirmed a network disruption and brought in cybersecurity experts but did not name the cause, though a separate district text called it a cyberattack. It had not said whether any data was accessed.
